record.paper_title: Boundary and Defect CFT: Open Problems and Applications
record.original_question: How should one incorporate finite-string-tension corrections, i.e. 1/λ corrections, into the large-N, large-'t Hooft-coupling analysis of four-point correlators in AdS5 × S5 supergravity?

evidence.quote: It would be interesting to discuss 1/λ corrections.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider type IIB string theory on the AdS_5 × S^5 background with N units of self-dual five-form flux, dual to four-dimensional N=4 supersymmetric Yang–Mills theory with gauge group SU(N) and 't Hooft coupling λ = g_YM^2 N. In the planar limit N → ∞ with λ fixed, four-point correlation functions of single-trace half-BPS superprimary operators (e.g., the stress-tensor multiplet superprimary O_2 of dimension 2) admit a strong-coupling expansion

⟨O O O O⟩ = G_sugra + λ^{-3/2} G_{R^4} + λ^{-5/2} G_{D^4 R^4} + λ^{-3} G_{D^6 R^4} + ⋯,

where G_sugra is the tree-level type IIB supergravity contribution on AdS_5 × S^5 and the subleading terms encode finite-string-tension (α'/L^2 ∼ λ^{-1/2}) higher-derivative stringy corrections.

Develop a systematic procedure to compute the 1/λ corrections G_{R^4}, G_{D^4 R^4}, G_{D^6 R^4}, … to four-point correlators of half-BPS operators at leading order in 1/N. Concretely: determine, in Mellin space or position space, the precise form of the holographic four-point amplitudes induced by the higher-derivative interactions (R^4 and its descendants) on AdS_5 × S^5, fix all coefficients consistently with superconformal Ward identities, crossing symmetry, and the flat-space α'-expansion of the type IIB four-graviton S-matrix, and identify the resulting anomalous dimensions and OPE coefficients of double-trace operators exchanged in the OPE.
artifact.status_search_result: Substantial progress has been made on incorporating 1/λ corrections to four-point correlators in AdS_5 × S^5. The leading R^4, D^4 R^4, and D^6 R^4 corrections to the stress-tensor multiplet four-point function have been computed in Mellin space using a combination of crossing symmetry, the flat-space limit, and supersymmetric localization constraints (Chester, Pufu, Yin and others). Higher-order α' corrections, full Kaluza–Klein generalizations, and a complete all-orders systematic procedure remain active areas of research, so the broader program is partially solved rather than completely settled.

status_evidence.title: Loop Corrections to Supergravity on AdS5 × S5
status_evidence.snippet: Subleading corrections in 1/N at large 't Hooft coupling correspond to loop corrections in supergravity, with crossing symmetry constraining their form.
status_evidence.claim: 1/N and 1/λ corrections to AdS5×S5 four-point correlators have been actively studied and partially computed.

status_evidence.title: 20' Five-Point Function of N=4 SYM and Stringy Corrections
status_evidence.snippet: Leading terms identified with supergravity, subleading with string α' corrections; supergravity needs weight-four functions while string corrections need only weight three.
status_evidence.claim: Stringy 1/λ corrections to holographic correlators have been computed, indicating partial progress.

status_evidence.title: Genus-2 holographic correlator on AdS5 × S5 from localization
status_evidence.snippet: R^4 correction fixed to any order in the genus expansion using mass-deformed sphere free energy constraints.
status_evidence.claim: Localization techniques have fixed leading 1/λ (R^4) corrections to high order.
